notes.title: Annapurna Interactive Puzzle Bundle
notes.content:
Hello Gorogoa players!

Today we're launching the Annapurna Interactive Puzzle Bundle, featuring four acclaimed, puzzle-centric games we've published. The games are...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497440/COCOON/

COCOON (Developer: Geometric Interactive)
Steam - Overwhelmingly Positive (95%)
Metacritic - 88
Winner - Best Independent Game (DICE Awards), Best Debut Indie Game (The Game Awards)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/557600/Gorogoa/
Gorogoa (Developer: Buried Signal)
Steam - Overwhelmingly Positive (97%)
Metacritic - 84
Winner - Innovation Award (GDC Awards), Best Debut Game (BAFTAs)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008920/Lorelei_and_the_Laser_Eyes/
Lorelei and the Laser Eyes (Developer: Simogo)
Steam - Overwhelmingly Positive (96%)
Metacritic - 89

https://store.steampowered.com/app/753640/Outer_Wilds/
Outer Wilds (Developer: Mobius Digital)
Steam - Overwhelmingly Positive (95%)
Metacritic - 85
Winner - Game of the Year (BAFTAs), Grand Prize (Independent Games Festival)
If you loved any of these games, we hope you'll give some others a shot. The bundle is available now, with an extra 10% discount on top of ongoing Summer Sale discounts.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42065/Annapurna_Interactive_Puzzle_Classics/

Thanks for playing!

-Annapurna Interactive
